stem:
Dev adds in a base-$6$ landmark system. In the ones place he holds $6$ copies of the $1$-landmark.

Which claim is correct before he reads the sum?

options.text: Call the step regrouping and stop after naming that label.
Leave all $6$ copies of the $1$-landmark unexchanged in the ones place.
Exchange the $6$ copies of the $1$-landmark for one copy of the $6$-landmark before reading the result.
In a base-$10$ system the same $6$ ones may also stay unregrouped, so skip the exchange here too.

teacher.key_rationale: In base 6, six ones equal one six-landmark, so exchange before reading. A labels only. B skips the exchange. D misapplies a base-10 habit.
